messages.content: Hey Alex! 👋 How's your week going so far?
Doing great! I've been working on a tool to export our Messenger chat history into printable PDF booklets. 🚀
Wait, really? That's such a cool idea! Can you customize the colors and fonts too? ✨
Yes! You can pick from preset themes like Classic Messenger Blue, Rose Pink, Dark Mode, or Warm Sepia Book—or pick any custom colors you want. 🎨
It also supports emojis, reactions, custom page sizes (A5, A4, Letter), and splits everything neatly by month or year.
Are we still on for coffee and book shopping this evening? ☕📚
Definitely! Let's meet at the corner café at 6:30 PM. See you there!
Happy July! ☀️ Ready for our summer road trip next week?
Can't wait! The route along the coast looks incredible 🏖️🌊
I'll pack the camera and playlist. We're going to have the best time! 📸🎶
